entries.reason: the header names the case: does nothing if the identifiers are invalid or not selected, or no photo library is specified in the configuration. On this port the last is always true - the configuration never names a library - and the first two follow from it, the picker's own results having no identifier to name
entries.effect: nothing is deselected, the arguments are read and the call returns; a configuration that names no library is the case the header itself calls doing nothing
entries.source: the differential of tests/backports/host/photosui, which asks the host's own PhotosUI and this port the same 38 questions and compares the answers line for line (34 the same, 4 outside what the host answers at all, each stated with its reason); the header of PhotosUI of the iOS 16.4 SDK for the contract and its wording
